body.question: What restrictions apply to construction under GRAP Stage III?

response.answer:
Under GRAP Stage III, there is a ban on construction and demolition activities
in the entire NCR, except for essential projects such as railways, metro,
airports, and national security. [1] Restrictions on BS-III petrol and
BS-IV diesel light motor vehicles may be imposed. [1] Under GRAP Stage I, mechanized sweeping and water sprinkling of roads shall be
enforced. [2] Post-intervention monitoring showed a measurable decline in coarse
particulate (PM10) at sites within 2 km of major construction clusters within
72 hours, attributed primarily to reduced dust re-suspension. [3]
